posts.text: The ASX is set to dip at the open, with index futures down 0.2%. It comes ahead of big earnings results this morning from Telstra, Origin, Transurban, ASX, and Insurance Australia Group. Overnight, US markets mostly lifted, with the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the Nasdaq adding 0.5%.

posts.text: US markets lifted from upbeat quarterly results from CoreWeave and other AI infrastructure firms, while mild inflation data reinforced bets that the US Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady in September. US CPI rose just 0.1% in July.

posts.text: US government bond yields were mixed after the benign US CPI figures and the government selling 10-year notes at a high yield of 4.683%, the highest in almost 20 years. The US 10-year Treasury yield was steady at 4.69% while the US 2-year Treasury yield dropped 1 point to 4.20%.
posts.original_text: US government bond yields were mixed after the benign US CPI figures and the government selling 10-year notes at a high yield of 4.683%, the highest in almost 20 years. The US 10-year Treasury yield was steady at 4.69% while the US 2-year Treasury yield dropped 1 point to 4.20%.
posts.translation_zh: 在温和的美国 CPI 数据公布以及政府以 4.683% 的高收益率发行 10 年期国债后，美国政府债券收益率涨跌互现，该收益率为近 20 年来的最高水平。美国 10 年期 Treasury 收益率持稳于 4.69%，而美国 2 年期 Treasury 收益率下降 1 个基点至 4.20%。
